summary: Validated the 403 Forbidden bug fix via the public preview URL (https://saas-architect-15.preview.emergentagent.com). All GETs (/, /activate, /login, /forgot-password, /admin/login) returned 200. All POSTs (Livewire /livewire-*/update for activation, /login, /logout, /forgot-password) returned 200/302 with correct redirects. NO 403 or 419 encountered anywhere in the flows. TrustProxies + URL::forceScheme('https') + APP_URL fix is working. Two unrelated issues were found: (a) the pre-seeded 'preview-verified@example.com' account has email_verified_at = NULL, so logging in redirects to /email/verify instead of /ambassador/dashboard, which blocks the dashboard-specific assertions in the spec; (b) Filament assets under /public/css/filament and /public/js/filament are missing, so the /admin/login page loads (200, no 403) but its UI is unstyled and Alpine errors fire in console (filament:assets was never published).

integration_issues.flow: Login as pre-seeded verified ambassador (preview-verified@example.com / previewpass1234) -> dashboard
integration_issues.issue: POST /login returns 302 (auth succeeds, no 403) but lands on /email/verify instead of /ambassador/dashboard. DB check: SELECT email_verified_at FROM users WHERE email='preview-verified@example.com' -> NULL. The seeder is not stamping email_verified_at on the 'verified' preview ambassador, so all dashboard-specific spec assertions (name 'Preview Verified Ambassador', PREVIEW1 code, /r/PREVIEW1 URL, [data-testid=copy-referral-link], [data-testid=copy-status] 'Copied!', [data-testid=dash-status]='Active', [data-testid=nav-logout] in sidebar) COULD NOT BE VERIFIED. Logout mechanism itself works: 'Sign out' link on /email/verify POSTs /logout -> 302 -> landing, session cleared (subsequent GET /ambassador/dashboard -> redirect to /login).

Page HTML returns 200 (no 403, primary bug fix confirmed) and Filament login form (email + password inputs) is rendered, BUT all Filament static assets 404 in browser: /css/filament/filament/app.css, /js/filament/filament/app.js, /js/filament/tables/tables.js, /js/filament/support/support.js, /js/filament/actions/actions.js, /js/filament/notifications/notifications.js, /js/filament/schemas/schemas.js, /js/filament/filament/echo.js, /fonts/filament/filament/inter/*. Directory /app/public/css and /app/public/js do not exist. Alpine console errors: 'filamentSchema is not defined', 'filamentSchemaComponent is not defined', 'filamentFormButton is not defined', 'isProcessing is not defined'. Fix: run `php artisan filament:assets` (Filament v3+) or `php artisan filament:upgrade` and ensure the vendor:publish for filament assets runs post-install. This is NOT a 403 problem but leaves the admin UI broken.

flows_verified_pass: Landing shows 'AIO Rewards' + 'Turn your AIO Media' copy, no 403.
[data-testid=cta-activate] navigates to /activate; all 8 activate-* form fields present.
Livewire activation submit with test_active+letmein succeeds and redirects to /email/verify (proves Livewire submit works over the HTTPS reverse proxy).

Livewire activation with an invalid provider (unknown username or test_inactive) shows [data-testid=activate-error-banner]. For unknown username the banner text is 'We could not verify your subscription. Please check your username and password.' (matches spec 'could not verify'). Note: could not use test_active+wrong to trigger this exact banner because test_active was consumed by the successful activation earlier in the same run; used an unknown username to elicit the same VerificationFailureReason::NotFound wording. Stays on /activate, no 403.
Login with wrong password stays on /login with [data-testid=login-error] text 'These credentials do not match our records.'.
Login with correct pre-seeded credentials returns 302 with no 403 (target page is /email/verify due to seed bug, not /ambassador/dashboard).
Sign out link posts /logout -> 302 -> landing; session cleared.
Forgot-password with preview-verified@example.com returns 302 and success flash keywords 'password reset', 'reset link', 'sent' are present on redirected page.
/admin/login returns 200 (no 403) and contains a Filament sign-in form with email + password inputs.
action_items: Seed fix: mark preview-verified@example.com as email-verified in the seeder (e.g., \App\Models\User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now(), ...]) or explicitly set email_verified_at = now() when re-seeding). Without this the dashboard flow cannot be exercised end-to-end.

Publish Filament assets so /admin/login renders correctly: run `php artisan filament:assets` and (if needed) `php artisan storage:link`; also add filament:assets to composer post-autoload-dump so it happens automatically on deploy.
No fixes needed for the reported 403 bug — TrustProxies + APP_URL/forceScheme changes are working across landing, activation (Livewire POST), login, logout, forgot-password, and Filament admin login.
critical_code_review_comments: bootstrap/app.php TrustProxies with at:'*' + X_FORWARDED_* headers is correct for the Emergent Kubernetes ingress; consider restricting `at` to the ingress CIDR in production for defense-in-depth.
AppServiceProvider::boot forcing HTTPS only when APP_URL starts with https:// is a good conditional; add an `if (config('app.env') !== 'testing')` guard if pest/phpunit needs http.
Seeder for preview-verified user should set email_verified_at explicitly to match /app/memory/test_credentials.md documentation (this is a documentation vs implementation drift).

success_rate.frontend: 9 of 11 spec bullets fully verified; 2 partially verified due to seed bug (dashboard details) and Filament assets 404 (admin UI). 0 of 11 flows produced a 403 — primary bug fix confirmed.

test_credentials: preview-verified@example.com / previewpass1234 (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Provider fake driver: test_active+letmein OK, test_inactive+letmein inactive, unknown username -> not found.
seed_data_creation: Created two activated ambassadors during testing: (a) testagent-<rand>@example.com via test_active+letmein (this consumed the test_active provider username for the rest of the test run), and (b) unknown_<rand>@example.com attempts that failed intentionally. Recommend running the ambassador seeder (or db:wipe + seed) before rerunning the activation spec so test_active is available again.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 403 bug is FIXED. Remaining spec-blocking issues are (1) seed: mark preview-verified@example.com email_verified_at = now(); (2) Filament assets 404 — run `php artisan filament:assets`. After both fixes, rerun the login->dashboard checks ([data-testid=copy-referral-link], [data-testid=copy-status], [data-testid=dash-status]='Active', [data-testid=nav-logout], name/email/referral display) and confirm /admin/login renders styled Filament UI. Provider username test_active is likely already consumed in the DB from this test run; either re-seed or use a new provider username stub if you extend the fake driver.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 403 RCA (confirmed by testing): Laravel sat behind the Emergent Kubernetes HTTPS ingress but (a) did not trust X-Forwarded-* headers, so request()->secure() returned false and Livewire's session/CSRF token was being generated against http scheme while the browser sent it back over https, and (b) APP_URL was http://localhost so URL::to() built http:// asset URLs and Livewire's asset URL mismatched the current origin, causing token/asset mismatches that manifested as 403. Fix: TrustProxies at:'*' with all X_FORWARDED_* headers + URL::forceScheme('https') + URL::forceRootUrl(config('app.url')) + APP_URL=https://saas-architect-15.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified by observing Livewire POST /livewire-*/update returns 200 and /login POST returns 302 (session persists cross-request) end-to-end through the preview URL.
